data.raw_text:
fresh Ilowa update. here's what changed and why it matters:

video streaming is live. go live from your camera or connect OBS directly, same setup as YouTube or Twitch. upload videos, build a library, get tipped while you stream. the player rotates, goes fullscreen, scrubs, supports speed controls and picture-in-picture. it behaves like a real media player because that's what it should be.

wallet UX is cleaner. send screen now has a QR scanner ; it had one on receive but not send, which never made sense. paste from clipboard actually works. two fixes that sound minor until you're standing in front of someone trying to pay you on the street and the app doesn't cooperate.

onboarding got rebuilt around passkeys. new users authenticate with Face ID or fingerprint. no seed phrase. no paper. nothing to photograph and post on Instagram by accident. the Elder for your region narrates the whole setup in your language. it feels like signing into a banking app because that's the experience it needs to match.

compliance hub is in. clear documentation of what Ilowa is (a non-custodial dApp) and what it isn't (a VASP, a custodian, an exchange). regional regulatory status for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Malaysia, India  and the Philippines. the policy engine, Arcium privacy, and Nillion key management aren't features we added; they're the compliance architecture. we just made it visible.

this is Ilowa getting more serious. not louder. Genesis100 signups 🔜 ✍🏽
